remarks: Stunning 2 acre property features both a main house and separate cottage. Situated on the New Canaan line on one of Wilton's most sought-after streets & steps to The Lake Club, this elegant and sophisticated, impeccably maintained Colonial has over $350k in renovations and upgrades! Approached by stately stone pillars & walls w/a NEW paved driveway, 3-car garage w/NEW EV wall charge & boasting 4/5 beds, 5 full baths w/a finished lower level, this home is incomparable. Featuring a NEW Generac whole house generator, NEW whole house water filtration system, NEW A/C, NEW Furnace, NEW well pump & well tank, NEW Walpole perimeter deer fence in backyard, gleaming hardwood flooring throughout & so much more-ask4list! Spacious bright & elegant marble foyer w/radiant heated flooring opens to Lg living room w/fireplace & cathedral ceiling, Lg formal dining rm w/fireplace, EIK w/radiant heated flooring, granite counters, NEW stainless appliances & eating area w/banquet seating. Step into the huge, freshly painted & carpeted family rm & sliders to NEW 3-season Sun room/patio enclosure overlooking the manicured backyard w/terraced stone walkway to bocce court and playground! The perfect venue for family living & entertaining. The primary bedroom has been completely renovated! Boasting a NEW custom walk-in closet, NEW primary spa bath w/soaking tub, separate shower & radiant heated flooring.
